s: Zeman hadlaqat nerot leshabbat ubo z' seipim: sapeq chasheka sapeq enah chasheka, vezehu niqra ben hashshemashot bekol maqom, vehu kede mahalak g' rebie mil (veod m"t ammot) qodem tzet g' kokabim benonim — asur laasot bo melaka min hattora, kevan shehu sepeq layla. Veim asa — chayyab asham taluy. Vaapillu dabar sheen issuro beshabbat ella middibre soperim — asur laasot gam ken beben hashshemashot. Vaapillu im nistappeq lo im hu ben hashshemashot o yom — en zeh kelum, shekkol sapeq habba mechamat chesron yedia eno kelum, sheim hu eno yodea acherim yodeim. Velidbar mitzva muttar laasot bah kol dabar shehaissur beshabbat atzmah hu middibre soperim. Veken im hu tarud venechpaz venitzrak ledabar shehu mishshum shebut ben hashshemashot — hare zeh muttar:

Lepikak muttar leareb erube chatzerot beben hashshemashot im lo ereb mibbeod yom, lepi shehu nechpaz venitzrak laerub kede sheyyukal letaltel bechatzer, vegam hu debar mitzva, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"v. Veken muttar lehatbil kelim beben hashshemashot im lo tebalam mibbeod yom vehu tzarik lahem leshabbat sheen lo kelim acherim. Veken muttar leasser perot im en lo mah yokal beshabbat, shezzehu tzorek mitzva. Abal asur lehaprish challa bechutz laaretz, shehare yakol leekol belo haprashat challa, uleshayyer meat ad achar hashshabbat, ulehaprish min hammeshuyyar. Umuttar leasser et haddemay ulehatmin et hachammin bedabar sheeno mosip hebel, mittaam shennitbaer besimman [ran]"z. Umuttar lomar lenokri lehadliq ner letzorek shabbat ben hashshemashot, shezzehu letzorek mitzva. Umuttar lomar lo lehadliq ben hashshemashot ner shel yom mitat abiv o immo, shemmeachar shehaolam nizharim bazeh hare zeh ketzorek gadol, vekol shehu tzorek gadol beinyan sheim lo yaasennu yihyeh lo tzaar — lo gazeru alayv beben hashshemashot, ap al pi sheen bo tzorek shabbat kelal. Veken bimqom hepsed merubbeh, lo gazeru al shebut beben hashshemashot. Abal asur leareb erube techumin beben hashshemashot, apillu lidbar mitzva vetzorek gadol vehepsed merubbeh, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman tt"v. Veod, lepi sheal yede haerub qoneh sham shebita, vahare zeh keqoneh qinyan beyadayim beshabbat, velo hittiru liqnot qinyan apillu beben hashshemashot uletzorek mitzva vehepsed merubbeh (sheshshebut zeh liqnot qinyan hu chamur mishshear kol hashshebutim), (sheissuro meporash bedibre qabbala, binchemya simman yag). Umikkol maqom, im abar veereb apillu lidbar hareshut — erubo erub, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tt"v:

Vekol zeh kesheadayin lo qibbel alayv shabbat, abal im kebar qibbel alayv shabbat bitpillat arbit shel shabbat shehitpallel mibbeod yom, o sheana "bareku" im hatztzibbur, o sherob hatztzibbur anu "bareku" ap al pi shehu lo ana immahem, shechal alayv hashshabbat beal korcho ap al pi sheeno rotzeh leqabbelo kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rs"g — asur lo laasot beatzmo kol shebut, apillu qodem ben hashshemashot, apillu lidbar mitzva vetzorek gadol, kegon lehatmin chammin leshabbat bedabar sheeno mosip hebel apillu en lo mah yokal beshabbat, veken leareb erube chatzerot ap al pi shetztzarik meod letaltel bechatzer tzorke shabbat, vekol kayyotze bazeh. Abal muttar lomar lenokri laasot apillu melaka gemura, vaapillu lidbar hareshut, im hu harbeh qodem hallayla, lepi shebbevadday yesh meqomot yisrael shello qibbelu adayin et hashshabbat veosim melakot apillu beatzman, veheak neesor leellu sheqqibbelu shello yaasu apillu al yede nokri. Abal im hu chatzi shaa qodem hallayla, sheaz epshar shekkol meqomot yisrael qibbelu kebar et hashshabbat — asur laasot al yede nokri apillu dabar shehu mishshum shebut apillu qodem ben hashshemashot, im hu lidbar hareshut veen sham sheat haddechaq. Abal lidbar mitzva o letzorek gadol — muttar laasot al yede nokri apillu melaka gemura, vaapillu beben hashshemashot, ap al pi shekkebar qibbelu hashshabbat, sheen machmirim beqabbalat shabbat yoter mibben hashshemashot belo qabbalat shabbat ella leinyan laasot beatzmo, abal leinyan amira lenokri en machmirim yoter mibben hashshemashot belo qabbalat shabbat, shemmuttar laasot bo kol melaka al yede nokri lidbar mitzva o tzorek gadol, kemo shennitbaer:

Yesh omerim shemitzvat aseh min hattora lehosip mechol al haqqodesh beissur asiyyat melaka biknisat shabbatot veyamim tobim ubitziatam, shenneemar "veinnitem et napshotekem betisha lachodesh baereb (meereb ad ereb tishbetu shabbattekem"), yakol yatchil veyitanneh betisha? Talmud lomar "baereb", i "baereb" yakol mishshettechshak? Talmud lomar "betisha", ha ketzad? Matchil umitanneh mibbeod yom, mikkan shemmosipim mechol al haqqodesh. En li ella biknisato, bitziato minnayin? Talmud lomar "meereb ad ereb". En li ella yom hakkippurim, yamim tobim minnayin? Talmud lomar "tishbetu". Shabbatot minnayin? Talmud lomar "shabbattekem", ha ketzad? Kol maqom shenneemar "shebot" — mosipim mechol al haqqodesh millepaneha uleachareha:

Zeman tosepet zeh millepaneha, hu mittechillat hashsheqia sheen hashshemesh niret al haaretz, ad zeman ben hashshemashot, vehu kede g' milin urebia, shemmittechillat hashsheqia ad tzet g' kokabim hu mahalak d' milin, uben hashshemashot hu qodem tzet hakkokabim mahalak g' rebie mil, nisharu g' milin urebia mittechillat hashsheqia ad ben hashshemashot. Vehazzeman hazzeh, im ratza laasoto kullo tosepet — oseh, ratza laasot mimmennu miqtzat — oseh, ubilbad sheyyosip ezeh zeman shehu vadday yom mechol al haqqodesh. Abal ben hashshemashot eno nechshab letosepet, shehare hu sepeq layla, veasur bo bimlaka min hattora belo mitzvat tosepet. Veim rotzeh lehaqdim uleqabbel alayv tosepet shabbat mippelag hammincha ulemala, dehaynu shaa urebia zemanniyyot qodem hallayla — hareshut beyado, veneesar baasiyyat melaka. Abal im qibbel qodem pelag hammincha — en qabbalato kelum, umuttar baasiyyat melaka. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla yesh lehachamir shello laasot melaka im qibbel shaa urebia zemanniyyot qodem techillat hashsheqia, lepi sheyyesh omerim shemmittechillat hashsheqia veelak hu layla gamur min hattora (sheaz hu zeman reiyyat g' kokabim benonim lepi dibrehem), uben hashshemashot shehu kede hilluk g' rebie mil qodem techillat hashsheqia, upelag hammincha hu shaa urebia zemanniyyot qodem techillat hashsheqia. Veyesh anshe maaseh sheosin lekattechilla kisbara zo, shepporeshim mimmelaka shaa urebia zemanniyyot qodem techillat hashsheqia. Abal en lemaher lehadliq hanner ulehitpallel arbit shel shabbat ad shaa urebia zemanniyyot sheqqodem tzet hakkokabim, velo sheqqodem techillat hashsheqia. Vaapillu bediabad im hidliq az hanner — tzarik lekabboto velachazor ulehadliqo letzorek shabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rs"g. Veken im hitpallel az — tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel achar kak, lepi shehaiqqar kisbara harishona.

Mi sheeno baqi beshiur ben hashshemashot veeno yodea meematay yosip alayv — (tzarik lehistalleq mikkol sapeq uleqabbel shabbat harbeh qodem techillat hashsheqia, velaken) yadliq hannerot beod shehashshemesh berashe hailanot. Veim hu yom hammeunnan — yadliq keshehattarnegolin yoshebim al haqqora mibbeod yom. Veim hu bassadeh sheen sham tarnegolin — yadliq keshehaorebim yoshebim sham mibbeod yom:

Yesh meqomot nohagim lomar "mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat" qodem "bareku", ubaamirat mizmor zeh hem meqabbelim tosepet shabbat alehem veneesarin baasiyyat melaka. Abal bimdinot ellu ap al pi shennohagim lomar gam ken mizmor zeh qodem "bareku", ap al pi ken osim kol hammelakot ad "bareku" mammash, lepi shemmittechilla keshehitchilu lomar zeh hammizmor — lo haya bedatam leqabbel tosepet shabbat baamirat mizmor zeh, ella baamirat "bareku":
